content: FastAPI UploadFile: read bytes with await file.read(), check content_type (client-supplied, spoofable), re-read with await file.seek(0). Use File()+Form() together for multipart with other fields. Optional file: UploadFile | None = None. For image validation, read first bytes for magic number check then seek(0) before full read — mirrors existing PDF magic-byte pattern in admin.py.
